title: Mordheim KB catalogue — catalog/skills/*.yaml
description: Skill definitions of the skill tables: `general.yaml` (skills every warband may learn) and `warband.yaml` (warband-specific skills). A skill is an editorial entry plus, when it has one, its runtime classification — the same `runtime` contract the band rules use.

kind.description: `general` skills live on the common tables; `warband` skills are gained by one or a few warbands.

category.description: Skill table the skill belongs to; it is the token profiles declare in `skill_access`.

effect.description: Editorial text of the skill as printed in its source.

engine_option.description: Engine option the skill compiles to, when it is executable outside the general mechanism catalogue.

rules_source_url.description: Canonical page of the skill's rules text.
